summary: A clear calendar. The whole day is yours.

headlines.title: Trump threatens Iran over rumored 'dirty bomb' plot
headlines.detail: Iran's foreign minister says the U.S. naval blockade must end before oil exports can resume.

headlines.title: Denmark links foiled assassination plot to Russia
headlines.detail: Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen tied the plot on Danish soil to Russian intelligence.

headlines.title: APEC in Shenzhen ends with nothing new on Taiwan
headlines.detail: Taiwan votes in local elections Nov. 28; Beijing reportedly subsidizes travel home for Taiwanese businesspeople to vote.

headlines.title: ADB: Taiwan leads Asia's growth, China lags
headlines.detail: Taiwan is projected at about 11% growth on AI chip demand; mainland China near the bottom at about 4.6%.

headlines.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra hits 'high' self-improvement risk level
headlines.detail: Released this week alongside Sol; per OpenAI's system card, it's the first OpenAI model to reach that threshold.

headlines.title: Trump threatens tax on overseas AI data centers
headlines.detail: He floated a heavy tax on U.S. firms building data centers abroad; details are still thin.

headlines.title: Venice Biennale closes with long-delayed prizes
headlines.detail: The awards ceremony, postponed since May after the jury resigned, takes place on the Nov. 22 closing day.

headlines.title: Nan Goldin opens at the Hayward Gallery
headlines.detail: 'You Never Did Anything Wrong' runs Nov. 24 to March 14 in London.
